items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: After that Red started this small group with Dave Barbour and Stuie Pletcher and Herbie Haymer, Pete Peterson.

ctx.x: I got the impression from what you said that he just wasn't a very good--an extremely polished musician, but he was a talented jazz trumpet player.
If you got that, that was fine, because I learned--I think I learned more jazz from Stuie because he would always try for things and miss, but it was his recouping that made the thing--
Miles Davis has made a career out of that.
